checks.title: Feature list exists
checks.guidance: Keep docs/FEATURES.md as the source of truth for feature priority.

checks.title: Architecture document exists
checks.guidance: Keep the current architecture overview in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

checks.title: Boundary rules exist
checks.guidance: Document dependency direction and layer ownership before adding more code.

checks.title: Refactoring plan exists
checks.guidance: Keep step-by-step refactoring guidance visible in docs/REFACTORING_PLAN.md.

checks.title: Decision records directory exists
checks.guidance: Use docs/decisions for architecture decision records.

checks.title: Architecture baseline ADR exists
checks.guidance: Keep the initial architecture decision record.

checks.title: ADR template exists
checks.guidance: Provide a template so future decisions stay consistent.

checks.title: Domain layer directory exists
checks.guidance: Keep domain rules independent from frameworks and infrastructure.

checks.title: Domain layer does not import outward layers
checks.guidance: Keep src/domain independent from application, interface, and infrastructure layers.

checks.title: Security policy domain exists
checks.guidance: Keep auth, RBAC, and project isolation rules in the domain layer.

checks.title: Application layer directory exists
checks.guidance: Use the application layer for use cases and workflow orchestration.

checks.title: Authentication service exists
checks.guidance: Keep registration, login, and session authentication as application use cases.

checks.title: Project workflow security service exists
checks.guidance: Keep workflow ownership and project isolation checks in application orchestration.

checks.title: Interfaces layer directory exists
checks.guidance: Keep delivery mechanisms at the edge of the system.

checks.title: Infrastructure layer directory exists
checks.guidance: Keep concrete integrations behind adapters.

checks.title: Password hasher exists
checks.guidance: Hash passwords with a concrete crypto adapter instead of storing raw secrets.

checks.title: Session token issuer exists
checks.guidance: Issue signed session tokens through an infrastructure adapter.

checks.title: Security repositories exist
checks.guidance: Keep persistence details behind repository adapters.

checks.title: Tests directory exists
checks.guidance: Add behavior-focused tests as implementation grows.

checks.title: Pull request template exists
checks.guidance: Use a PR template to make architecture checks part of code review.

checks.title: CI workflow exists
checks.guidance: Keep an automated validation gate for pushes and pull requests.

checks.title: Architecture doc states dependency direction
checks.guidance: The architecture doc should describe dependency direction and the domain boundary.

checks.title: Boundary doc states layer ownership
checks.guidance: The boundary doc should identify ownership for the core layers.

checks.title: PR template includes architecture check
checks.guidance: The PR template should remind reviewers to check architecture boundaries.

checks.title: CI workflow runs validation commands
checks.guidance: CI should run both the test suite and the architecture review.
